risks.title: Risky integration of BPI in Portugal
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in CaixaBank's analysis, language highlighting an 'unusual' impact on ratios, stable trend since acquisition, high weight due to linkage with a major strategic operation.

risks.title: Increased competition from local universal banks
risks.score_rationale: Referenced indirectly through comparison with other local banks, measured but implicit language, stable trend, moderately weighted category.

risks.title: Increased banking regulation under Basel III
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned with reference to Basel III and capital ratios, strong technical and normative language, upward trend in regulatory pressure, high weight in the banking sector.

risks.title: Dependence on European stress tests
risks.score_rationale: Present via stress tests from the European Banking Authority, serious and preventive language, stable trend, high weight regarding compliance and market confidence.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of banking systems
risks.score_rationale: Not directly mentioned here, but a critical business risk implicitly present for any digital bank, expected language in a 10-K, upward trend, high weight in the financial sector.

risks.title: Pressure on return on equity profitability
risks.score_rationale: Raised through analysis of ROE and ROTE showing strong growth but under pressure, positive yet cautious language, stable trend, high weight for shareholders.

ai_positioning.summary: CaixaBank is gradually adopting artificial intelligence in its digital services, primarily for process automation and customer support. The approach remains cautious, focused on operational efficiency rather than disruptive innovation.
evidence: Use of automation tools for customer service
